entities.summary: Jessica St. Clair is an American actress and improvisational comedian from the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre. With frequent collaborator Lennon Parham, she co-created and co-starred in NBC's Best Friends Forever and USA Network's Playing House. Recently she was a lead voice on the Adult Swim animated comedy Royal Crackers.
